title: No Space GTA Yet — But You Can Still Be a Space Outlaw
summary:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is out, and lots of gamers are excited. But Rockstar Games, the company behind it, has never made a GTA game set in space. So what can you play if you want to be a space outlaw? No game has done that idea perfectly yet, but a few come close.

In Starfield, a huge space game, you can pick your own path. You can save the galaxy, or you can turn to crime. A special mode lets you start over and live a different life, so trying a criminal career is part of the fun.

The Outer Worlds 2 is a smaller, funny game. You play a star-surfing scoundrel, and the story lets you choose: be good, or be a troublemaker.

No Man's Sky lets you lead pirate fleets and steal spaceships. Star Wars Outlaws, from 2024, may be the closest match. You play Kay Vess, a scoundrel like Han Solo, dodging stormtroopers and rival gangs. It jumps between maps on different planets, so it never feels quite as smooth as a Rockstar game, but it gets at least halfway there.
why_it_matters: It helps you pick the right game when you want an adventure where you choose to be a hero or a troublemaker among the stars.

background_read: Grand Theft Auto is a series of games where players explore a big city and can choose to follow the rules or break them.
Rockstar Games makes these games, and the newest one, Grand Theft Auto 6, is set on Earth, not in space.
Other space games let players act like outlaws among the stars, choosing between being a hero or a troublemaker.
